That port keeps the full web surface (subscribe/unsubscribe/getState/getLastMessageAt/hasEverConnected/connect/disconnect), the per-event listener Map, capped 1s->60s exponential backoff, lastMessageAt/hasEverConnected freshness bookkeeping, and the connected/vehicle_update/alert/export_status/achievement_unlocked/heartbeat/disconnected dispatch — but probes globalThis.EventSource (the useAchievementUnlocks/sseClient pattern) instead of constructing the browser global, resolves /api/v1/events through the native apiUrl helper, and uses the RN-global setTimeout. When no EventSource polyfill is present (the RN default) doConnect is a no-op that leaves state in the explicit 'reconnecting' (live wiring unavailable) value the web manager reports before first connect, so the hook reports connected=false and never throws.
